title: Private DAST and GitOps CD assurance
expected_outcome: Establish evidence-backed private DAST and GitOps CD verification without exposing a private EKS endpoint or granting a CI identity deployment authority.
constraints: DAST must run only from an approved private runner after an Argo Application is Synced and Healthy.
No workflow may use static cloud credentials, kubeconfig, Vault token, or private endpoint in logs or artifacts.
A DAST failure must block promotion evidence but must not mutate workloads or send signing traffic.
Deployment authority remains in the approved GitOps repository; this repository cannot impersonate that authority.

external_actions: read-only GitHub Actions, GitOps repository, AWS, and private EKS inspection

primary_owner.responsibility: security architecture, workflow integration, final evidence

validation: private runner dry-run only after explicit approval
